Backend upload accepts filename=*.mov + Content-Type=video/quicktime and returns 200 in <2s (fully background). Video is streamable IMMEDIATELY (persistence-first) — do not wait for status=ready before asserting a 200 on /video. After ready, Content-Type on the video stream becomes video/mp4 (proof conversion ran).
